legality_basis: span_source / reference_source / legality_tier are deliberately ABSENT. The 2026-08-15 legality doctrine's either-field rule is resolved by core.legality inside core.driver.run_experiment, and this cell does not fly that harness -- it flies core.flight.FlightRuntime, which never reads those keys. Declaring three keys no code on this path resolves would be dead config, the same defect this fragment's prompt_position_basis avoids elsewhere. The substance is stated and enforced instead: the brief's only source is the corpus's own metadata table, pinned by path and sha256 above and re-hashed on every read; no gold, reference, annotation or external byte can reach it; and core.metadata_brief has no code path through which one could.
task_instruction: The reference material above is a pre-meeting brief for this call, built only from the Earnings-22 corpus's own published metadata row for it: the ticker symbol, the country, the UN region, the major dialect family and the language family. Where a value shows a form in brackets after "normalized:", that is the spelling the measurement compares against. It is reference material ONLY, to help you spell names and terms you actually hear, and to tell you what kind of English to expect. Transcribe the speech verbatim exactly as spoken. Never insert, repeat, or add any listed word you do not clearly hear in the audio. Output only the transcript text.
instruction_basis: The transcription half of this string -- 'Transcribe the speech verbatim exactly as spoken. Never insert, repeat, or add any listed word you do not clearly hear in the audio. Output only the transcript text.' -- is byte-identical to the sealed comparator's own instruction (configs/baseline/e22-esb-dev1500-tail2s.json), except for the one word 'listed', which the KC-E1 Earnings-21 brief instruction already carries for the same reason: a brief that is read aloud shows up as insertions, and the arm must say so. The brief-describing preamble is the KC-E1 instruction's, re-worded field for field for this carrier's five metadata facts. THE CONTRAST AGAINST THE SEALED COMPARATOR THEREFORE MOVES BOTH THE EVIDENCE AND THE TASK INSTRUCTION and is reported as such; the ONE-factor contrast is against KU-E2c, whose instruction is byte-identical to this one.
evidence_basis: core.evidence's e22-metadata-brief source, whose two-line source slice (the metadata table's header line plus this call's data line, both verbatim) is re-derived by core.evidence_derivation.DerivedEvidenceRegistry before the flight opens a server. carrier_bound is False and core.metadata_brief's module docstring says why: D1 records this table's 125 ids through a _csv_layer and no per-file manifest, so there is no per-sample evidence identity to check against and this source does not fabricate one. The table's BYTES are pinned above instead, by path and sha256, and re-hashed on every read.
token_match_precondition: THIS FRAGMENT IS THE UNPADDED ARM AND IS NOT WHAT FLIES. The padder for this carrier is SYMMETRIC (core.metadata_brief.pair_pad_repeats), because a real Earnings-22 brief can be longer than the one it twins: on the two Oceania calls -- whose briefs are the corpus's shortest, 'Oceania' being the only one-word UN region -- every fact-distinct partner is longer, so the pair meets in the middle instead of the twin always growing. Before takeoff the flight agent runs scripts/e22_kc_e2_prompt_fit.py --write-pad-plan against the resident server, commits configs/knowledge/e22-brief-v1/pad-plan-v1.json, and edits exactly two keys here: evidence_source becomes 'e22-metadata-brief-token-matched' and an evidence_brief_pad_plan pin is added. What this arm then gains is 1 to 3 neutral ' item' repeats per line under the model-free whitespace measurement -- token volume, and no fact, no name and no sector. KU-E2c takes the same two-key edit against the same pinned plan.
external_sources: NONE. Owner ruling 2026-09-07: Earnings-22 must not collect any external information, or the result stops being comparable with the academic references. The corpus table carries no company name, no ticker-to-legal-name lookup exists in this repository, and core.metadata_brief has no field and no code path that could add one.
prompt_position_basis: The brief reaches the model as the head of the SYSTEM message, ahead of the instruction (prompt_order 'evidence-first-system-v3'), in the same '[evidence <id>] <content>' line format core.model.transport renders supplied_evidence in. This carrier flies core.flight.FlightRuntime -- one harness for every arm, owner 2026-09-03 -- and that harness assembles through rails.task_adapter.TaskAdapter.assemble_prompt rather than core.policies.build_arm_payload, so the payload's field set stays exactly ARM_VISIBLE_FIELDS['bare-core'], the sealed comparator's own. The one factor between this arm and KU-E2c is the system text and nothing else.
scorer_basis: asr-wer-esb-whisper stays the paper-facing anchor and asr-wer-esb reports the frozen saea-scoring-v1 number beside it, both unchanged from the comparator. brief-term-recall-v1 is this cell's own targeted metric, preregistered before any KC-E2 number existed (docs/readiness/2026-09-07-e22-kc-e2-pre-meeting-brief-v1-preregistration.md section 5) and measured on the comparator first (docs/readiness/2026-09-07-e22-brief-source-audit-v1.md). entity-wer is absent by construction: data.carriers registers no entity layer for earnings22-original. Scoring runs once over the complete manifest through core.scoring_batch, never sharded.
obs_basis: There is no OBS loop here and no windowing: an ESB utterance IS the request. policy 'fixed' sends exactly one contact per sample through core.flight.FlightRuntime's own concurrent dispatch, exactly as the sealed comparator did.
why_a_separate_baseline_fragment: Each cell's composed config_hash -- and therefore its protocol_hash and its exposure row -- must be movable only by an edit to ITS OWN fragments, the reason configs/baseline/e22-esb-dev1500-q8.json already records. This arm and KU-E2c differ in exactly two keys, evidence_source and the twin's own evidence_brief_derangement pin.
